newsitem.title: UK: Videologic shares up on Sega speculation.
newsitem.headline: Videologic shares up on Sega speculation.

text.p: Shares in UK multimedia chip designer Videologic Group Plc rose in early trading on Friday, after a newspaper said it was close to signing a deal to supply Sega Enterprise's next generation of video games.
Videologic's shares were up 3.0 pence at 50 pence at 0730 GMT. At one stage the shares had been up 4.0 pence.
The Daily Telegraph said the group was "believed to be close to signing a lucrative deal to supply its virtual reality technology" to Sega Enterprises Ltd.
On Wednesday Sega said it would not be using graphics chips made by Videologic's Californian rival 3Dfx Interactive Inc as had been expected.
The paper said analysts believed the deal could transform Videologic's annual sales.
